name: ART
model_family: Anonymous Region Transformer for variable multi-layer transparent generation
notes: Official repository states that runnable code, pretrained weights, and checkpoint links were removed on 2025-07-23 because of concerns about training-data provenance.

name: AutoFigure
model_family: Agentic scientific illustration generation and iterative refinement
notes: Official repository provides a runnable paper/text-to-figure pipeline and web interface; it is an agent workflow rather than a task-specific checkpoint release.

name: AutoFigure-Edit
model_family: Editable scientific illustration generation and refinement
notes: Official open-source repository is available; the system composes external models and does not require a dedicated released checkpoint.

name: AutoPP
model_family: Automated product-poster generation plus CTR-oriented preference optimization
train_datasets: AutoPP1M product-poster generation and optimization subsets
eval_datasets: Offline poster-generation metrics; online CTR feedback
notes: Repository releases AutoPP1M data but states that training and inference code for IDPO are coming soon; no canonical checkpoint release was located.

name: CGL-GAN
model_family: Composition-aware GAN for visual-textual presentation layouts
notes: The authors' repository still states that code will be released soon; the dataset is public, but no implementation release is present there.

name: CreatiDesign
model_family: Multi-conditional diffusion transformer
notes: Public repository provides inference and benchmark evaluation; training code is not documented in the README.

name: Design First Code Later
model_family: Design-first template-free slide-generation workflow
backbone: Configurable LLMs plus SlideQwen design/implementation models
notes: Runtime pipeline and SlideDesign resources are public; weight-release status should be tracked separately.

name: Design Your Ad
model_family: Unified autoregressive personalized advertising image-text generation
output_format: Personalized advertising image and product text
notes: Official repository releases trained checkpoints and inference code. The complete PAd1M training set is still marked coming soon, with test data and a demo training set available.

name: DesignAsCode
model_family: Code-native agentic graphic-design generation
train_datasets: DesignAsCode training data (~19K distilled Crello samples)
notes: Planner training, full inference pipeline, released planner weights, and retrieval assets are public.

name: GlyphDraw2
model_family: LLM-guided triple-cross-attention diffusion for glyph poster generation
notes: Official repository provides both training and inference scripts; a canonical released GlyphDraw2 checkpoint was not verified.

name: LayerD
model_family: Iterative raster-to-layer decomposition with matting and refinement
notes: Official repository documents inference, training, evaluation, and released default model weights.

name: LayerDiffuse
model_family: Latent-transparency adaptation for transparent image generation
output_format: Single or multiple transparent RGBA layers
notes: Official entry page points to inference integrations and states that dataset/training-code release was planned; released weights are available on Hugging Face.

name: LayerFusion
model_family: Training-free harmonized multi-layer generation with generative priors
output_format: Foreground RGBA; background RGB; composite RGB
notes: Project page still labels code as coming soon; method is optimization/training-free and does not introduce a task-specific released checkpoint.

name: LayoutDETR
model_family: Detection-transformer-style multimodal layout generation
backbone: DETR-style multimodal conditioning; generative layout backbone
output_format: Structured foreground layout; rendered ad banner
notes: Official repository includes preprocessing, training, evaluation, in-the-wild generation, dataset release, and a pretrained checkpoint.

name: LayoutDM
model_family: Discrete diffusion model for controllable layout generation
notes: Official repository includes training, inference, evaluation, preprocessed data, FID assets, and pretrained checkpoints.

name: LayoutFlow
model_family: Flow-matching model for continuous layout generation
notes: Official repository includes training and evaluation; Hugging Face hosts datasets, pretrained models, and evaluation assets.

name: LayoutFormer++
model_family: Conditional sequence-to-sequence layout generation
notes: Official Microsoft repository provides training and evaluation code; Hugging Face hosts datasets and pretrained task checkpoints. The repository was archived in September 2026.

name: Constrained Graphic Layout Generation via Latent Optimization
model_family: GAN-based structured layout generation
notes: Official repository includes training, generation, evaluation, a download script for pretrained models, and CLG-LO constraint optimization.

name: LayoutNUWA
model_family: Code-generation formulation for layout generation
notes: Official repository includes data conversion, training, inference, and evaluation; a canonical released task-specific checkpoint was not located.

name: LayoutPrompter
model_family: Training-free in-context LLM layout prompting
notes: Training-free method; the Microsoft LayoutGeneration repository was archived in September 2026 but remains readable.

name: MRT
model_family: Masked-region diffusion for unified layered generation and editing
train_datasets: 10M+ multilingual layered design samples; 43M+ transparent layers
notes: Project page documents the model and data scale, but no public code or checkpoint release was located.

name: PaperBanana
model_family: Reference-driven multi-agent academic illustration generation
output_format: Raster methodology diagrams and statistical plots
notes: Official implementation is maintained as PaperVizAgent; the workflow orchestrates external models rather than releasing a task-specific trained checkpoint.

name: PosterCopilot
model_family: LMM layout reasoning and layer-controllable editing
notes: Training recipe is documented, but the public repository currently exposes inference and rendering rather than training scripts.

name: PosterForest
model_family: Training-free multi-agent scientific-poster generation
notes: Training-free system; weights depend on the selected external or local foundation models.

name: PosterLayout
model_family: Content-aware poster layout generation with DS-GAN
backbone: Visual feature encoder; GAN layout generator
notes: Official repository includes training, testing, evaluation, dataset instructions, and downloadable pretrained DS-GAN weights.

name: PosterLLaMA
model_family: Vision-language model for content-aware poster layout generation
notes: Official code documents two-stage training and inference and links to a released PosterLLaMA checkpoint.

name: PosterMaker
model_family: Two-stage product-poster generation with scene synthesis and accurate text rendering
eval_datasets: Released stage-1 and stage-2 poster benchmarks
output_format: Raster product poster with specified text regions
notes: Official repository released inference and weights on 2025-04-18 and training code on 2025-11-12.

name: PrismLayers
model_family: ART+ multi-layer transparent image generation
output_format: Multiple RGBA layers plus composite image
notes: Repository provides ART+ demo code and checkpoint download instructions; no verified end-to-end training entry point was recorded here.

name: PSDesigner
model_family: Tool-using layered graphic-design agent
notes: The public repository currently releases CreativePSD; PSDesigner code and GraphicPlanner weights remain on the TODO list.

name: Qwen-Image-Layered
model_family: Variable-layer image decomposition diffusion model
train_datasets: Internal text-to-RGB/RGBA data; PSD-derived multilayer image corpus
output_format: Variable-length RGBA layer stack; PSD/PPTX export
notes: Official repository provides runnable decomposition/editing utilities and released weights; training code was not located.

name: RALF
model_family: Retrieval-augmented autoregressive layout transformer
notes: Official repository includes training, inference, evaluation, dataset preprocessing, retrieval indexes, checkpoints, and generated results.

name: RefAdGen
model_family: Product-preserving advertising diffusion with spatial control and attention fusion
backbone: Stable Diffusion v1.5; IP-Adapter; GroundingDINO; SAM2
notes: Official repository documents model training components and Predictor-based inference and links the released model artifact.

name: Scan-and-Print
model_family: Autoregressive content-aware layout generation
notes: Training, inference, and evaluation scripts are public; no canonical trained-weight release was located.

name: SciForma
model_family: Structure-faithful scientific diagram diffusion with M-DPO
notes: Official repository includes training and generation paths, released SciForma-9B/SciForma-Base weights, dataset, and benchmark links.

name: SciPostLayout
model_family: Scientific-poster layout analysis and generation baselines
notes: Repository includes training and evaluation for layout analysis/generation plus paper-to-layout experiments.

name: SlideGen
model_family: Collaborative multimodal slide-generation agents
notes: Agentic pipeline rather than a released task-specific checkpoint.

name: TAUE
model_family: Training-free noise transplantation and cultivation for layer-wise generation
notes: Official repository currently contains project documentation but no runnable implementation at the repository root, so the repository link is not treated as a verified code release.

name: TextDiffuser
model_family: Two-stage diffusion framework for text rendering
notes: Official code includes training, inference, evaluation, released checkpoints, and MARIO data resources.

name: TextDiffuser-2
model_family: Language-model-assisted diffusion for flexible text rendering
backbone: Stable Diffusion v1.5; LLM layout planner
train_datasets: MARIO-style text-image data; layout-planner instruction data
notes: Official repository contains full/LoRA training paths and inference code; full fine-tuned and LoRA weights are released on Hugging Face.

name: TKG-DM
model_family: Training-free chroma-key content generation through initial-noise optimization
output_format: RGB image with controlled chroma-key background
notes: Official implementation is a training-free inference pipeline using stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0.

name: Towards Reliable Advertising Image Generation Using Human Feedback
model_family: Reliable-feedback-guided recurrent advertising generation and diffusion fine-tuning
backbone: Stable Diffusion v1.5-compatible latent diffusion; ControlNet
notes: Official repository provides runnable inference and a fine-tuned ControlNet checkpoint; a public end-to-end training entry point was not verified.

name: PosterCraft
model_family: Unified diffusion poster generation with staged text and aesthetic optimization
notes: Official repository provides inference and demo code plus released model weights; no public end-to-end training entry point was located. Authors report partial dataset release.

name: PosterOmni
model_family: Unified multi-task image-to-poster generation and editing via task distillation and reward feedback
notes: Official repository provides inference for six poster tasks and released transformer weights; public training code was not located.

name: Seeing is Improving: Visual Feedback for Iterative Text Layout Refinement
model_family: Visual-feedback multimodal layout refinement with supervised and reinforcement learning
notes: Official repository releases supervised fine-tuning, reward-model, reinforcement-learning, and inference code and states that VFLM model checkpoints and the Text Layout Reward Model were released.

name: OmniPSD: Layered PSD Generation with Diffusion Transformer
model_family: Unified layered PSD generation and decomposition
notes: Official repository provides training and inference code for text-to-PSD and image-to-PSD and links a released 10k-row layered-poster dataset subset; a canonical checkpoint download was not confirmed during this audit.

name: PSDiffusion: Harmonized Multi-Layer Image Generation via Layout and Appearance Alignment
model_family: Simultaneous harmonized multi-layer diffusion generation
backbone: Pretrained image diffusion model with global-layer interaction
output_format: RGB background + multiple RGBA foreground layers
notes: Official repository exists, but its TODO still lists inference code, pretrained model, and Inter-Layer Dataset as future releases.

name: Mirror in the Model: Ad Banner Image Generation via Reflective Multi-LLM and Multi-modal Agents
model_family: Reflective multi-agent multimodal ad-banner generation
backbone: Configurable Gemini or GPT multimodal/image-generation API models
notes: Official Sony repository provides a minimal runnable multi-agent artifact; it composes external API models and does not release a task-specific trained checkpoint.

name: UTDesign
model_family: Unified diffusion framework for stylized-text editing and generation
backbone: Diffusers; FLUX VAE; DINOv2 visual conditioning; CLIP style encoder; multimodal layout planner
train_datasets: Gray-scale and colored font data; annotated design-image data including Kingsoft-provided data
output_format: RGBA foreground glyphs; raster graphic-design images
notes: Official repository provides inference pipelines, a Gradio demo, multi-stage training instructions, and released Hugging Face checkpoints.

name: SlideTailor
model_family: Personalized agentic scientific slide generation
notes: Official repository releases the runnable generation/evaluation pipeline and PSP dataset; the system uses API-based agents rather than a task-specific released checkpoint.

name: ArcDeck
model_family: Narrative-driven multi-agent paper-to-slide generation
backbone: Configurable GPT/Claude/Qwen/vLLM language models; python-pptx/PptxGenJS rendering
notes: Official repository provides a runnable CLI, web UI, Claude Skill, and released ArcBench dataset. The workflow uses configurable foundation models and releases no task-specific trained checkpoint.

name: SciFig
model_family: Multi-agent editable scientific-figure generation
notes: Official project page currently marks both Code and SciFig-Bench as Coming Soon. No public implementation or task-specific checkpoint was verified; the benchmark is described as 435 human-verified figures across 37 arXiv domains and 15 venues.
